title: Jat Jati ke Mukammal Halat yani Jat Dar-pan, Part I
author: M.L.C. Gupta
current_text: The Local Government ordered all copies of Jat Jati ke Mukammal Halat yani Jat Dar-pan, Part I forfeited to His Majesty; the author applied to have the order set aside, but the Allahabad High Court found that he had failed to show the book did not promote enmity and hatred between different classes.

sources.quote: This is an application by the author of a book called "Jat Jati ke Mukammal Halat yani Jat Darpan, Part I," under Section 99-B, Criminal Procedure Code, for an order to set aside the order passed by the Local Government under Section 99-A forfeiting to His Majesty all copies of his book.
sources.title: M.L.C. Gupta vs Emperor on 20 January, 1936

sources.quote: I am, therefore, of the opinion that the applicant has entirely failed to show that the book did not contain matters which promoted feelings of enmity and hatred between different classes.
sources.title: M.L.C. Gupta vs Emperor on 20 January, 1936

sources.quote:
Allahabad High Court
M.L.C. Gupta vs Emperor on 20 January, 1936
Equivalent citations: 162IND. CAS.507, AIR 1936 ALLAHABAD 314
JUDGMENT
Sulaiman, C.J.
sources.title: M.L.C. Gupta vs Emperor on 20 January, 1936

ban_rows.note: Forfeiture order (year not documented) by the Uttar Pradesh government under Section 99-A of CrPC 1898; Section 153A IPC. Motif: «The court held that the book promoted hatred and enmity by representing Jats as low, criminal and immoral, and that its objectionable passages were not saved merely because they were mixed with other material.». Forfeiture upheld by the Allahabad High Court on 1936-01-20. Case: M.L.C. Gupta vs Emperor. Subject: «Jat Jati ke Mukammal Halat yani Jat Dar-pan, Part I».
